> switch to build mode


    Use /build or press Tab.
    [ Copy ]





 Commands:
>  /help   Show help
  /plan  Plan mode
  /build  Build mode
  /verbose
    Toggle verbose output
  /thinking
    Toggle thinking display
  /theme  Switch theme
  /skill  Load a skill
  /diagnostics
    LSP diagnostics
  /undo
    Restore the last tool
    call's files
  /goal
    View, create, pause or
    resume the goal
  /pin
    Keep the last turn out of
    compression
  /unpin
    Clear a pin on the last
    turn
  /drop
    Drop the last turn from
    this context
  /keep
    Keep a file's reads out of
    compaction
  /unkeep  Drop a kept path
  /remember
    Store a fact for later
    sessions
  /memory
    List or forget stored
    facts
  /sandbox  Sandbox status
  /model  Switch model
  /fork  Create session branch
  /session  List/switch branch
  /exit  Exit TinyCode
↑↓ navigate · Enter execute ·
Esc cancel
